Why Waxahachie businesses miss calls

Waxahachie is the Ellis County seat, south of Dallas on I-35E, with one of Texas’s best-known historic courthouses. Manufacturing employs 13% of workers, among the highest shares of the Texas cities we cover. Older homes, new subdivisions and nearby rural properties all need service. Many companies here are small, so the owner is often driving between jobs when a new customer calls.

Can you keep your Waxahachie phone number?

Yes. Waxahachie callers will usually see the 214, 469, 972 and 945 area codes, and you can keep the number customers already know. What to check before you go live

  1. Test real calls: ask awkward questions, not only easy ones, and listen to how it handles them.
  2. Set the rules: decide which calls transfer to a person and which become messages.
  3. Plan your minutes: estimate your busiest month, not an average one.
  4. Tell callers what you need to: Texas is generally treated as a one-party consent state for recording calls, but rules differ for callers in other states, so check with your advisor if you record calls.
